clips.title: Pages
clips.line: A class is a series of pages, not one endless board.

clips.title: Bring back a deleted page
clips.line: A page you delete is kept, and can be brought back, even after a reload.

clips.title: Editor and projector, half the screen each
clips.line: Teach in one window while the class sees the presenter window, which follows every stroke.

clips.title: A video on the board
clips.line: Open a video from the Files tab and it plays on the board, with its captions beside it.

clips.title: A YouTube link on the board
clips.line: Paste a YouTube link in the Files tab and the video plays on the board.

clips.title: Stickers, emoji and GIFs
clips.line: A bar of emoji and GIFs that come with the app: click one and it lands on the page.

clips.title: Put a picture on the board and crop it
clips.line: Open a picture from the Files tab, put it on the board, and crop it to the part you need.

clips.title: Write and run code on the board
clips.line: A code editor in the browser: write a short program, press run, and its output appears below.

clips.title: An animated flowchart
clips.line: Pick a kind of chart in the Flow tab, put it on the page, and play it step by step.

clips.title: Connect an AI assistant to the board
clips.line: Add the MCP server to your assistant, pair the board with a code, and the assistant draws on it.
